verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a hybrid workflow: develop and iterate locally, then share and scale in the cloud. It also offers a local MCP server pointed at local DuckDB databases, so an agent can work against local data instead of the cloud warehouse. This is MotherDuck's own capability, but nothing describes a dedicated sandbox or dev environment, and the read-only MCP restriction is an adjacent control rather than a sandbox. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/dev environment or database-cloning/branching feature, documented separation of test vs production data for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
